question: Sattriya was recognised in ______ as a Classical Dance by Sangeet Natak Akademi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sattriya** is an esteemed Indian classical dance form that was officially recognized by the **Sangeet Natak Akademi **in the year 2000.
 
• Its origins trace back to the 15th century A.D., when the revered Vaishnava saint and reformer of Assam, Mahapurusha Sankaradeva, introduced it as a potent medium for spreading the Vaishnava
